scenes.vo: Last night I knocked on my own door. Inside, in my own voice, it whispered: Who's there?
I blinked. I was on my couch, inside 9C. The clock said three oh one. We had SWITCHED places.
Then the knocking started. Mrs. Dorsey's voice. Then Nora, crying. Then my MOTHER, calling me sweetheart.
But I knew the rules. I didn't answer. I didn't open. When the peephole went DARK, I didn't look.
It knocked all night. At five fifty nine, it stopped.
A folded note slid under the door, in Nora's handwriting. The note said: Rule FOUR.
